title: Software Developer
summary: Software Developer with 4+ years of hands-on experience building and optimizing high-quality Spring Boot microservices, RESTful APIs, and Kafka-driven workflows in Agile telecom environments. Strong in PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, JUnit/Mockito, and React.js. Focused on clean, scalable OSS/BSS delivery for Telstra and Bell Canada with measurable quality, automation, and performance gains.

bullets: Built a Spring Boot microservice generating XML offer catalogs consumed by a downstream provisioning system to onboard 1,100+ roaming offers, price plans, and entitlements for enterprise subscribers.

Delivered 8+ features covering flat-rate offer generation and active-plan eligibility validation, cutting invalid catalog output by 22% and centralizing error handling, KPI tracking, and audit logging via a shared validation utility.
Authored 100+ JUnit and Serenity BDD tests via GitLab CI/CD with feature-toggle rollout, reaching 85%+ coverage across all plan flows.

Developed and maintained 20+ Spring Boot microservices using PostgreSQL for telecom OSS platforms, supporting 100K+ daily service orders through Kafka-based orchestration and automated order fulfillment.
Enhanced the Service Order Management (SOM) platform, improving end-to-end order processing efficiency by 30%, and led the migration of 30+ REST APIs to a new Apigee API Management platform.
Architected a robust inventory management module featuring advanced filtering and pagination, directly improving data retrieval efficiency by 40% for key users.
Improved application performance by 25–35% through SQL query optimization, connection pooling, caching, and performance tuning.
Deployed and managed 15+ containerized microservices on Kubernetes, achieving 99.99% application availability, and optimized the Parallel MEC Distribution process, reducing deployment time by 50%.
Built a SoapUI automation framework that reduced manual testing effort by 40% and execution time by 60%, while collaborating on 30+ features and 10+ production releases in an Agile environment.
Developed AMEND and CANCEL functionalities for the Complex Logistics Microservice, enhancing telecom order lifecycle management.
Resolved 200+ defects across SIT and UAT environments while achieving 100% security compliance by fixing SonarQube and Docker vulnerabilities.
Increased JUnit test coverage from 30% to over 80%, ensuring high code quality with minimal duplication and zero critical production defects.
Delivered 30+ features with cross-functional Agile teams through root cause analysis and on-time release execution.
Completed a focused internship on enterprise software delivery workflows and production readiness practices.
Developed an internal product management system using JSP, Servlets, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
